#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

#include <functional>

using namespace std;

// FastReader: reads tokens from stdin
class FastReader {
private:
    istringstream iss;
    string line;
public:
    FastReader() {}
    string next() {
        while (iss.eof() || iss.peek() == EOF) {
            if (!getline(cin, line)) return "";
            iss.clear();
            iss.str(line);
        }
        string token;
        iss >> token;
        return token;
    }
    int nextInt() {
        return stoi(next());
    }
    long long nextLong() {
        return stoll(next());
    }
    // other methods not used can be omitted
};

// FastWriter: writes to cout
class FastWriter {
public:
    void println(long long x) {
        cout << x << '\n';
    }
    void println(int x) {
        cout << x << '\n';
    }
    void println(const string& s) {
        cout << s << '\n';
    }
    void flush() {
        cout.flush();
    }
    // other overloads not used can be omitted
};

// Modulo class for modular arithmetic
class Modulo {
private:
    long long mod;
public:
    Modulo(long long mod) : mod(mod) {}

    long long plus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a + b;
        if (c >= mod) c -= mod;
        return c;
    }

    long long minus(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = a - b;
        if (c < 0) c += mod;
        return c;
    }

    long long times(long long a, long long b) {
        return (a * b) % mod;
    }

    long long pow(long long a, long long b) {
        long long c = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if (b & 1) c = (c * a) % mod;
            a = (a * a) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return c;
    }

    long long div(long long a, long long b) {
        return times(a, pow(b, mod - 2));
    }

    long long combination(int n, int k, const vector<long long>& facts) {
        if (k < 0 || k > n) return 0;
        return div(facts[n], times(facts[k], facts[n - k]));
    }

    vector<long long> factorials(int n) {
        vector<long long> f(n + 1);
        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            f[i] = (f[i - 1] * i) % mod;
        }
        return f;
    }
};

// Main class E
class E {
private:
    FastReader in;
    FastWriter out;

public:
    void run() {
        int t = 1;
        while (t--) {
            solve();
        }
        out.flush();
    }

    void solve() {
        int n = in.nextInt();
        long long kt = in.nextLong();

        if (kt >= n) {
            out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        int k = (int)kt;
        Modulo mod(998244353);
        vector<long long> facts = mod.factorials(n);

        long long ans = 0;
        int c = n - k;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
            long long t = mod.times(mod.combination(c, i, facts), mod.pow(c - i, n));
            if (i % 2 == 0) {
                ans = mod.plus(ans, t);
            } else {
                ans = mod.minus(ans, t);
            }
        }
        ans = mod.times(ans, mod.combination(n, n - k, facts));

        if (k > 0) ans = mod.times(ans, 2);
        out.println(ans);
    }
};

int main() {
    E e;
    e.run();
    return 0;
}
